verdict.rationale: LightSprint is an agent platform that runs coding agents in cloud sandboxes, so a per-action approval mode is a fair question for it. The evidence describes background cloud agents and human review of PRs before merging. Nothing documents a configurable setting that switches an agent from confirming each action to auto-approving all of them.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one
